usedFor: Webinar activity in Webinargeek, like “New Registration”, creates booking links in Calendly with “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Webinargeek, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Someone who signs up for a webinar gets a booking link made for them, giving you a next step.

watchOut: “New Live Viewer” skips replays, and every Webinargeek trigger here is polling, so links follow on a schedule.
